round_2_targeted_leads.method: No new registry query. Round 2 read the 100 recorded hits of query yaml for parser packages and added targeted documentation leads for Kotlin/JVM, Scala and wrapper YAML libraries that are outside the first 100 hits (kaml, SnakeYAML Engine KMP, circe-yaml, Jackson 3 YAML, configuration loaders over SnakeYAML). Each lead's deps.dev directDependentCount was summed over all Maven releases with the same method as the round-1 capture (scripts/capture_yaml_registry.py deps_dev); SnakeYAML's recomputed value matched the recorded 10,859.

round_3_targeted_leads.method: No new registry query. Round 3 read the remaining undecided hits of the recorded query yaml (first 100) and added targeted documentation leads for Scala, Kotlin and Java YAML libraries and configuration loaders outside the first 100 hits. Each lead's deps.dev directDependentCount was summed over all Maven releases with the round-1 method (scripts/capture_yaml_registry.py deps_dev); where a single release's :dependents endpoint answered 404 it was counted as 0 and listed in releases_without_dependents_data.
round_3_targeted_leads.note: Every positive-metric parser lead among the recorded first-100 hits and the named Scala/Kotlin/Java YAML libraries is decided in leads.json. The other first-100 hits are webjars/npm mirrors, BOMs and channel manifests, validators, converters, plugins and tests, or have a zero deps.dev metric (zero_metric_hits_not_leads); a zero-metric path gets no slot. Coordinates in no_deps_dev_package have no deps.dev package record (not on Maven Central or not indexed).

round_4_targeted_leads.method: Round-4 targeted lookup, no new registry query. Discovery routes beyond the recorded Maven Central 'yaml' window: (1) perlpunk/yaml-runtimes list.yaml and the YAML test-suite matrix (matrix.yaml.info) list only SnakeYAML and SnakeYAML Engine for Java, both selected; (2) deps.dev reverse-dependency samples (directSample) of every release of org.yaml:snakeyaml, org.snakeyaml:snakeyaml-engine and com.fasterxml.jackson.dataformat:jackson-dataformat-yaml, read for YAML-named dependents (3,813 distinct dependents over 243 releases); (3) GitHub repository search 'yaml parser' for languages java, kotlin, scala, clojure and groovy, each hit looked up on Maven Central; (4) awesome-java, awesome-scala, awesome-clojure YAML entries. Each lead's deps.dev directDependentCount was summed over all Maven releases with the round-1 method (404 per release counts 0). GitHub stars were not used.
round_4_targeted_leads.note: No round-4 lead qualifies, so the cell stays at six. GitHub-only YAML parsers without a Maven Central release (FastYaml, yamlion, LSYAML, MiniYaml, java-fast/yaml, kaitai_yaml, zaml) have no registry package and no metric. Zero-metric coordinates get no slot (dahgan-loader is dahgan's loading API; yaml-json and joy-yaml are JSON-P providers over SnakeYAML Engine; micronaut-serde-yaml a serde format; tree-sitter-yaml a CST grammar). Simple-Yaml (Bukkit-style configuration over SnakeYAML) and clj-yaml (Clojars) have no deps.dev Maven package.

round_6_targeted_leads.method: Round-6 targeted lookup. (1) Maven Central Solr searches beyond the round-1 'yaml' query: 'yaml parser' (17 hits), 'yaml-parser' (4), 'yml' (551; first 100, almost all fabric8 Kubernetes app manifests), 'snakeyaml' (75), 'a:yaml' (20), 'yaml kotlin' (16), 'yaml scala' (20); each hit not already recorded was classified from its coordinate, POM and jar, and every plausible parser lead got a deps.dev value with the round-1 method (directDependentCount summed over all releases). (2) Named JVM leads: Kotlin Multiplatform korlibs/korio Yaml, RAML yagi, YAMLScript, yamlstar, tethys-yaml, clj-yaml (no deps.dev package, recorded in round 4). Candidates were probed locally on both valid controls where they have their own parse step.
round_6_targeted_leads.not_leads: Other new hits are not YAML parser leads: fabric8 Kubernetes app/package manifests ('yml'), Camel/Quarkus/Karaf/Spring Boot SnakeYAML data-format integrations, walterjwhite/qsy7 dependency BOMs and serialization providers, snakeyaml-engine-kmp native/JS targets (the selected KMP project), scala-yaml native/JS cross-builds (scala-yaml fails), kotlin-wrappers kotlin-yaml (JavaScript js-yaml bindings), webjars/mvnpm npm packages, codegen and Maven plugins, and the zero-metric coordinates above.
round_6_targeted_leads.note: No round-6 lead is promoted, so the cell stays at six. org.raml:yagi (32) passes both controls but has no documented input API; korio-jvm (212) and the korge korlibs YAML module fail both controls.
